buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading and equilibration.

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the experiment.

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as recorded in eLabFTW).

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting used during loading (as configured in automation).
pump_speed.unit: arbitrary units or mL/min as configured

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition on the plate.

resin_mass.description: Total resin mass per well used for loading isotherm calculation.

ligand_name.description: Name of the ligand or protein whose loading is measured.

total_volume.description: Total liquid volume per well for the loading experiment.

venting_time.description: Time spent on venting during the automated process.

salt_concentrations.description: Salt concentrations used in the experiment; may be a semicolon- or comma-separated list in eLabFTW.

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles before loading.

equilibration_volume.description: Volume used in each equilibration step.

ligand_concentrations.description: Ligand concentrations used in the experiment; may be a semicolon- or comma-separated list in eLabFTW.

incubation_temperature.description: Incubation temperature for the loading step.

measurement_wavelength.description: Measurement wavelength used on the Tecan plate reader.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve relating absorbance to concentration.

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution used for dilutions.

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations (e.g. µM, mg/mL).

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution used for dilutions.

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve relating absorbance to concentration.

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations specified in the design.

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations specified in the design.

analysis_status.description: Status of the loading isotherm analysis as reported by the analysis script.

message.description: Summary message from the analysis script.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database (UTC).

summary.description: Key metrics aggregated from analysis outputs.

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of ligand concentrations used (from analysis metadata).

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of salt concentrations used (from analysis metadata).

replicates.description: Number of replicates per condition (from analysis metadata).

n_wells_processed.description: Total number of wells successfully processed.

n_conditions.description: Number of unique (ligand, salt) conditions aggregated.

data_files.description: Output data file names from the analysis script.

plots.description: Plot files generated by the analysis script.

warnings.description: Warnings generated during analysis, if available.

raw_analysis.description: Full JSON object loaded from analysis_results_<id>.json for traceability.

result_folder_listing.description: Listings of the results and analysis folders for debugging.
